name: citybuddy-category-rag-v2
description: Bilingual retrieval regression suite covering every CityBuddy leaf category.

documents.text: Restaurant serving complete sit-down meals and regional cuisine; ristorante con servizio al tavolo e cucina locale.
Cafe for coffee, tea, breakfast and pastries; caffetteria per caffè, colazione e dolci.
Bar serving cocktails, aperitivo and alcoholic drinks; locale per cocktail, aperitivo e bevande.
Traditional pub with beer, ales and informal evening atmosphere; pub con birra e atmosfera informale.
Fast food counter for quick takeaway meals; ristorazione veloce e cibo da asporto.
Museum preserving and interpreting collections, history, science or cinema; museo con collezioni culturali o scientifiche.
Art gallery exhibiting paintings, photography and contemporary visual art; galleria d'arte e fotografia.
Visitor attraction and notable sightseeing destination; attrazione turistica da visitare.
Theatre presenting plays, drama and stage performances; teatro per spettacoli e rappresentazioni teatrali.
Commemorative monument, statue or memorial; monumento, statua o memoriale commemorativo.
Historic site with preserved heritage, archaeology or historically important buildings; sito storico e patrimonio.
Scenic viewpoint or belvedere with a panoramic city view; punto panoramico e belvedere.
Public park with lawns, trees and paths for outdoor recreation; parco pubblico con prati e sentieri.
Designed botanical or ornamental garden with plants and flowers; giardino botanico o ornamentale.
Children's playground with swings, slides and play equipment; area giochi per bambini.
Indoor fitness centre or gym for workouts and exercise classes; palestra e centro fitness.
Sports centre with courts, pitches or facilities for organised sport; centro sportivo con campi e impianti.
Nightclub for dancing, DJs and late-night entertainment; discoteca con DJ e ballo.
Live music venue hosting concerts and musical performances; locale per concerti e musica dal vivo.
Local market with stalls selling produce, food and regional goods; mercato locale con bancarelle.
Supermarket grocery store for everyday food and household shopping; supermercato alimentare.
Shopping centre or mall containing many shops under one roof; centro commerciale con numerosi negozi.
Public library for books, reading, study and borrowing; biblioteca per leggere, studiare e prendere libri in prestito.
Community centre for neighbourhood activities, meetings and shared social space; centro comunitario e casa del quartiere.
Official tourist information office providing maps and visitor guidance; ufficio informazioni turistiche.
Christian church for Catholic, Orthodox or Protestant worship; chiesa cristiana per il culto.
Mosque for Islamic prayer and Muslim worship; moschea per la preghiera islamica.
Synagogue for Jewish prayer and worship; sinagoga per il culto ebraico.
Hindu temple or mandir for Hindu worship; tempio induista e mandir.
Buddhist temple or meditation centre for Buddhist practice; tempio buddhista e meditazione.
Sikh gurdwara for Sikh prayer, congregation and langar; luogo di culto Sikh e gurdwara.
Other place of worship whose religion is unspecified or outside the named categories; altro luogo di culto non specificato.
Hotel providing private rooms and conventional visitor accommodation; albergo con camere private.
Hostel providing budget accommodation, shared dormitories and communal facilities; ostello economico con dormitori.
